dynamic_core_ownership: Evaluate all actual checks; delegate only the named formal checks for full PR/group validation. Core owns all remaining non-timing checks. Dudect callback builds and evidence-validator fixtures do not execute or admit timing qualification.

conformance_component.admission: both configured plans and all required parameter variants/modules; suite available-plan/module discovery and canonical Java result identities may not be replaced by current reduced results; dynamic external inventories remain held

dudect.admission: Version 5 per-case observation contract: all ten Nix or eleven legacy executions, including three synthetic controls in each suite; complete PR/periodic schedule, disjoint pilot, observed raw/statistic counts, native support, and unchanged 21-case/102-statistic/eight-look multiplicity allocation. Protected-input observations and negative controls require eligible nondetection; designated positive statistics must detect; public/authentication fixture characterization retains differences without secret-independence claims. Source/artifact-bound raw output, successful process exit and complete original-run diagnostics are required, including bound ordered timestamps/classes for every pilot and measured batch, native batch context and the ct_eq_128 synthetic input trace. Missing or partial evidence cannot publish success; original failures remain retained without statistical retry. Nix build reuse supplies executables only; The commissioned external qualification route must execute afresh. Historical failures and full product-assurance obligations remain unchanged.
dudect.execution_boundary: External qualification only. Hosted/Nix callbacks and evidence-validator fixtures are functional checks; historical observation requirements below remain the physical qualification baseline, not a claim that ordinary CI collected observations.

fstar.admission: each scheduled module admitted against invocation digests and actual load/dependency records; full imported libraries/include order/checked files and solver identity retained; source module listing not proof of actual verifier closure

fuzz.admission: all seven exact targets nonempty build+actual libFuzzer run, budgets/toolchain/sanitizer/seed-corpus/crash/evidence binding; complete transitive local Cargo dependencies, build scripts, native/generated inputs, headers, tools and configuration must be independently bound; omitted inputs hold admission

infrastructure_component.admission: all required modules nonempty provider-schema, readonly lock init/validate, resource/runtime/template/support contracts; no cloud plan/apply or deployment claim

kani.admission: full required+diagnostic selection, exact source/manifest/config/features/target/solver/property inventory and gate/citation replay; required and diagnostic dispositions separate

native_wasm.admission: both required lanes with exact native compiler artifact and each 1-test result; all vector groups and Node/web helper identities equal the protected baseline, nonempty results, bound WASM/import/ABI/adapter dependencies; dynamic helper catalog retained as constructor source pending exact independently reviewed expansion

npm_component.admission: all six explicit pinned Node consumers; exact installed lock graph, complete audit before consumers, lifecycle allowlist and entrypoint checks; no partial graph or script substitution

python_component.admission: exact 17, zero failed/errors/skipped; complete installed/audited application graph equality

sanitizer.admission: all Cargo compiler-artifact binaries and full baseline test IDs, zero selection/skip/ignored failures; exact target/features/profile/ASan runtime/preload/instrumentation/canary association; regex filenames or source candidates cannot substitute compiled inventory

tamarin.admission: all exact selected theory/lemma pairs final-summary admission with registry-bound wellformedness exceptions; unselected proof files preserved as potential inputs, not automatically proved

retired_fixture_rule: Guarded forbidden fixture surface remains absent; no production fixture seed or retired claim regeneration.
selected_result_rule: Every selected original lane succeeds; actual producer/result inventory separately admitted. No process or derivation equality substitutes nonempty execution and expected-ID completeness.
